messages:
statusbot: Incident notice: spike in 503 responses for hosted generation endpoints in eu-central and us-west starting ~11:05 UTC. Affected: /v1/generate (sync + streaming). Status page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2053009999

liam (sre): Investigating. Early signals point to connection churn on ingress proxies after a config tweak to socket timeouts deployed at 10:50. Correlating metrics now.

jen (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. Preparing rollback of the timeout change in eu-central; will follow with us-west if mitigation succeeds.

ops-bot: Autoscale executed: +4 serving nodes added in eu-central (action id: act-9922).

tara (support): Noticed several support tickets and an internal SLA alert. Drafted customer note using incident template; holding for SRE go-ahead.

liam (sre): eu-central rollback applied, healthchecks green. 503 rate dropping from ~9% -> ~1.1% in last 5m. Kicking off us-west rollback. Please refrain from additional deploys to ingress until postmortem.

jen (eng-runtime): us-west rollback complete. Rolling restart of proxies to clear stale sockets. Monitoring.

liam (sre): Current status: both regions showing baseline error rates. Incident mitigated. Postmortem owner: jen (eng-runtime). ETA for writeup: 72 hours. Closing broadcast; follow the status page for final notes.
